headline: DEBT CLEARED: Americas G&S Exits 592,000-oz Silver Stream, Issues 7.9M Shares to Sprott
snippet: Americas Gold and Silver (TSX: USA / NYSE-A: USAS) agreed to terminate the remaining 592,000 oz silver delivery obligation to Sprott Mining by issuing 7,956,696 shares at a deemed price of US$5.57, removing the last major streaming overhang from its balance sheet and restoring full exposure to rising silver prices.

headline: SILVER SPIKES 2.4% to $76/oz — Gold/Silver Ratio Squeezes to 59 as Physical Buyers Step In
snippet: Spot silver surged 2.4% on May 21 to $76/oz as physical buyers stepped in aggressively on the recent pullback, compressing the gold/silver ratio to 59 — its tightest reading in months. Gold held steady above $4,500, with the ratio compression typically signalling silver is in the late stage of a bullish metals advance.

headline: PMET RESOURCES Fires Up 45,000m Drill Campaign at Feasibility-Stage James Bay Lithium Deposit
snippet: PMET Resources (TSX: PMET) reopened the Shaakichiuwaanaan camp in James Bay, Quebec — one week ahead of schedule — and launched a 45,000-metre drill campaign with up to 8 rigs targeting the CV5 and CV13 spodumene pegmatites at a project with an 84.3 Mt reserve at 1.26% Li2O from a 2025 feasibility study.

headline: COPPER JUMPS to $6.30/lb — Iran Peace Talks and AI Data Centre Demand Fuel Base Metals Rally
snippet: Copper climbed to $6.30/lb on May 22, up 0.66%, as Trump confirmed the US was in final-stage Iran negotiations — raising hopes for Strait of Hormuz shipping resumption — while AI data centre buildout kept longer-term demand expectations elevated. J.P. Morgan estimates data centres alone will consume ~475,000 tonnes of copper in 2026.

headline: IMPACT SILVER Posts Record $11.3M Profit as Q1 Revenue Nearly Triples to $31.2M at $77.91/oz Realized
snippet: IMPACT Silver (TSXV: IPT) reported Q1 2026 revenue of $31.2 million — nearly triple year-ago levels — driven by 268,470 oz production at 80% higher silver grades and a $77.91/oz realized price. Record net income of $11.3 million with $45.3M cash and zero long-term debt, a textbook example of operating leverage on a rising silver price.

headline: GR SILVER DRILLS BEST-EVER HOLE: 45.1m at 1,623 g/t Ag Including 8.25m at 8,579 g/t Ag
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSXV: GRSL) reported hole SMS26-04 as the best-ever result from its San Marcial deposit in Sinaloa, Mexico: 45.1 metres at 1,623 g/t Ag equivalent including 8.25 metres at a stunning 8,579 g/t Ag. The result confirms deep structural controls on high-grade mineralization and opens new resource expansion potential at depth.

headline: NEXGOLD Drills 15.21 g/t Gold Over 20.1m at Goldlund, Expanding Ontario Open-Pit Resource
snippet: NexGold Mining (TSXV: NEXG) reported 14 new drill holes at the Goldlund Deposit in its Goliath Gold Complex in northwestern Ontario, led by 15.21 g/t Au over 20.1 metres, 5.11 g/t over 21.8m, and 4.51 g/t over 21.9m. Results confirm mineralization continuity at depth, supporting open-pit resource expansion in the 25,000m 2026 campaign.

headline: MINRES REBOOTS Bald Hill Lithium Mine After 18-Month Pause as Spodumene Prices Recover
snippet: Mineral Resources (ASX: MIN) restarted its 100%-owned Bald Hill hard-rock lithium mine in Western Australia's Goldfields region — placed on care and maintenance in November 2024 — with site activities commencing late May, mining in June, and first shipment targeted Q1 FY2027. The restart positions MinRes as the only company globally operating three hard-rock lithium mines.

headline: URANIUM DEMAND SURGE: US ISR Producer Eyes Major Texas Expansion as Utilities Ditch Russian Supply
snippet: A US in-situ recovery uranium producer is accelerating expansion of its Texas operations as domestic utilities rush to secure non-Russian supply chains. The push comes as Washington fast-tracks domestic nuclear fuel production and uranium spot prices stabilize around $83/lb — well above most US ISR producer operating costs.

headline: MICHAEL OLIVER on GoldSeek: Silver Entering 'Copper 2005' Structural Breakout — Gold Target $8,500
snippet: Veteran technician Michael Oliver tells GoldSeek that silver has broken a 50-year price ceiling in a setup structurally identical to copper's 2005 breakout — which led to a 400%+ multi-quarter gain. Oliver projects silver reaching 'the couple hundreds' and gold potentially hitting $8,500 if it replicates historical eightfold base-pattern breakouts.
